skill.summary: Automatically generate unit tests from functions with comprehensive coverage and edge cases

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Automatic Test Generator.

- Analyzes source code to generate comprehensive unit tests, including edge cases and error scenarios
- Supports multiple frameworks (Jest, Vitest, Mocha+Chai, Pytest, Go, JUnit)
- Automatically mocks dependencies and external services for isolation
- Handles both simple functions and complex classes, improving test coverage and consistency
- Saves significant development time and helps prevent production bugs
